info.title: orkeon 1.0.0-rc.7 — build and run AI agent crews.
info.description: Command-line entrypoint for Orkeon crews: `orkeon run <crew.ork.ts | crew.yaml>` — runs both the Scripting DSL (.ork.ts, Jint + esbuild) and YAML crew definitions from a single pre-compiled tool.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Score a dataset (running a crew per case with --crew), benchmark, compare reports, evaluate a RAG collection.

commands.name: bench
commands.description:
Score a dataset several times per case and report mean and standard
deviation; compare with a baseline report.

options.name: --runs
options.description:
(Default: 3) Runs of the suite per case (default
3).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
A report written by eval bench or eval run: the run
is compared with it, and exits 1 on a regression.

options.name: --threshold
options.description:
(Default: 0.05) Absolute score drop that counts as
a regression (default 0.05).

options.name: --dataset
options.description:
Required. Evaluation dataset: a JSON array of cases
with task_description, expected_output, output,
context, expected_format, metadata. Without --crew
every case needs its output.

options.name: --evaluators
options.description:
Comma-separated evaluators of the default suite:
format, schema, text-quality, similarity,
tool-accuracy, and with --llm-judge coherence,
fluency, groundedness. Default: all the registered
ones.

options.name: --llm-judge
options.description:
(Default: false) Add the LLM-as-Judge evaluators
(coherence, fluency, groundedness): sets
Evaluation:EnableLlmJudge for this run. Needs an
LLM.

options.name: --offline
options.description:
(Default: false) Zero-network run: the LLM judges
stay off (refused with --llm-judge), and a --crew
must run on the mock provider (--llm-mock <file>,
or Llm:Provider: mock in the settings).

./.orkeon/eval).

options.name: --min-score

1) is under this threshold.

commands.name: rag
commands.description:
Evaluate a RAG collection against a golden dataset (recall@k, MRR,
groundedness; judge mode labelled); writes markdown/JSON reports.

options.name: --dataset
options.description:
Required. Golden dataset YAML (e.g.
examples/rag/eval/golden.yaml). Its 'corpus'
directory is ingested first (incremental).

options.name: --collection
options.description:
Collection to evaluate (default: the dataset's
collection, else 'rag-eval-{dataset name}').

options.name: --profile
options.description:
Profile to evaluate: fast, balanced, quality,
adaptive, corrective, or default (the configured
Orkeon:Rag:Profile). Default: 'default'.

options.name: --compare
options.description:
Comma-separated profiles to compare (e.g.
fast,balanced,quality) — one report per profile
plus a comparison table. Overrides --profile.

options.name: -k
options.description:
(Default: 5) Cutoff of recall@k / precision@k
(default 5).

options.name: --llm-judge
options.description:
(Default: false) Judge generation with the
configured LLM; falls back to the deterministic
heuristic (mode always labelled in the report).

options.name: --offline
options.description:
(Default: false) Zero-network run: generation is
replaced by a deterministic extractive stub
(retrieved passages verbatim), so no LLM key is
needed.

options.name: --no-ingest
options.description:
(Default: false) Skip the corpus ingestion pre-pass
(the collection must already be ingested).

options.name: --reindex
options.description:
(Default: false) Force a full corpus reindex.
Required with the default in-memory store when
./.orkeon manifests survived a previous process,
and after an embedding model change.

options.name: --min-recall
options.description:
Anti-regression gate: exit 1 when the aggregate
recall@k (cases tagged 'correctif' excluded) drops
below this threshold.

options.name: --min-mrr
options.description:
Anti-regression gate: exit 1 when the aggregate MRR
(cases tagged 'correctif' excluded) drops below
this threshold.

options.name: --output
options.description:
(Default: /output/rag/eval) Virtual directory
receiving the markdown/JSON reports (default
/output/rag/eval → ./.orkeon/rag/eval).

commands.name: run
commands.description:
Score a dataset with the default evaluation suite; with --crew, run
a crew on every case first. Writes a JSON report.

options.name: --crew
options.description:
Run this crew (.yaml, .ork.ts or a crew directory)
on every case before scoring: the case's
task_description is the crew's prompt (the input
and the initial context), its final output replaces
output in the report. The dataset file is never
modified.

options.name: --llm-mock
options.description:
With --crew: answer every LLM call of the crew from
this JSONL file, offline (as orkeon run

options.name: --llm-record
options.description:
With --crew: record every LLM call of the crew in
this JSONL cassette (as orkeon run --llm-record).
Exclusive with --llm-replay and --llm-mock.

options.name: --llm-replay
options.description:
With --crew: answer every LLM call of the crew from
this cassette, recorded by --llm-record, with no
network (as orkeon run --llm-replay). Exclusive
with --llm-record and --llm-mock.

options.name: --llm-profile
options.description:
With --crew: run the crew on this host LLM profile
(as orkeon run --llm-profile).

commands.name: init
commands.description: Configure this machine: pick an LLM provider, write the settings file.

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Provider preset: ollama | docker-model-runner | openai |
custom | none. Omit to run the interactive wizard.

options.name: --base-url
options.description:
LLM endpoint base URL. Required for --provider custom;
presets have their own default.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Model identifier. Required for --provider custom; presets
have their own default.

options.name: --api-key-env
options.description:
Environment variable that will hold the API key. The file
names it (Llm:ApiKeyEnvVar) and every run reads it —
default ORKEON_Llm__ApiKey, which the runtime reads
natively and needs no reference. The key is never written
to the file.

options.name: --api-key
options.description:
API key stored INLINE in the generated file — discouraged
(plain text). Prefer --api-key-env.

options.name: --path
options.description:
Target file (default: the global per-user path,
%APPDATA%\Orkeon\appsettings.json /
~/.config/Orkeon/appsettings.json).

options.name: --force
options.description:
(Default: false) Overwrite the target file if it already
exists.

options.name: --no-probe
options.description:
(Default: false) Skip the connectivity probe after
writing the configuration (CI/offline).

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: probe
commands.description:
Exercise the LLM test protocol against a live provider and archive
the trace.

options.name: --provider
options.description:
Required. Provider: openai | anthropic | ollama | azure |
together | qwen | deepseek | kimi | mistral | huggingface
| zai | gemini | grok | minimax | openrouter | mammouth;
decision providers: typesafe | liquid | kev.

options.name: --model
options.description:
Model identifier. Defaults to the provider's default
model.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Base URL override. Required for Azure OpenAI.

options.name: --api-version
options.description:
Azure OpenAI api-version (deployment mode). Omit to
exercise the v1 GA surface.

options.name: --workspace-id
options.description:
Workspace id for workspace-scoped keys (Anthropic
identity-linked keys require it).

options.name: --thinking-effort
options.description:
Base reasoning-effort hint (e.g. none). For models that
refuse tools while reasoning; M7 still probes thinking
explicitly.

options.name: --m7-effort
options.description:
Reasoning effort M7 probes with (default low). For models
whose supported set excludes low.

options.name: --api-key-env
options.description:
(Default: ORKEON_LLM_API_KEY) Name of the environment
variable holding the API key. The key itself is never
accepted on the command line.

options.name: --modes
options.description:
Comma-separated protocol modes (e.g. M1,M2,M8; D1–D8 for
a decision provider). Defaults to every mode the
provider's family supports, except the paid D8.

options.name: --archive
options.description:
Directory to write the campaign report to. Nothing is
archived when omitted.

options.name: --format
options.description:
(Default: md) Output format: md (default, human-readable)
or json (for the campaign scripts).

options.name: --commit
options.description:
Short commit of the tree under test, recorded in the
report. The harness does not shell out to git.

options.name: --timeout
options.description:
(Default: 180) Per-request timeout in seconds (default
180). The first call to a local model pays for loading it
into memory.

options.name: --temperature
options.description:
(Default: 0) Sampling temperature (default 0). Raise it
only for a model that rejects a pinned temperature.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Serve the host's tools to an MCP client (Claude Desktop, an editor) over stdio.

commands.name: serve
commands.description:
Serve this host's tools to an MCP client over stdio: JSON-RPC in on
stdin, out on stdout, one message per line.

options.name: --settings
options.description:
Path to appsettings.json (defaults to the current
directory's resolution chain, like `orkeon run`).

options.name: --tools
options.description:
Comma-separated names of the tools to serve
(default: every tool of the host). A name the host
does not have refuses the start.

options.name: --max-concurrency
options.description:
How many requests are served at once, at least 1
(default 4, or MCP:Server:MaxConcurrency); the
others wait their turn.

options.name: --expose-output
options.description:
Serve /output as read-only MCP resources
(orkeon:///output/<path>), through the host's
virtual file system. /workspace is never served.

options.name: --crew
options.description:
Serve a crew as the tool run_crew_<name> (its name,
lower case), its input the {placeholders} of its
tasks, its result the crew's final output, with
progress when the client sends a progressToken; its
tasks are also offered as prompts. Several crews go
space-separated after ONE --crew (the flag cannot
be repeated). Budget, guardian and permission gate
are those of `orkeon run`.

options.name: --allow-external-mounts
options.description:
(Default: false) Allow a --crew whose folder is
outside the working directory, as `orkeon run
--allow-external-mounts` does. Can also be enabled
via ORKEON_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_MOUNTS=1.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Score a dataset with the default evaluation suite; with --crew, run a crew on every case first. Writes a JSON report.

options.name: --settings
options.description:
Path to appsettings.json (defaults to same dir as
script).

options.name: --mount
options.description:
File system mount(s) in Docker-style format:
<physical>:<virtual>:<rights>[;sub:rights]. Several
mounts go space-separated after ONE --mount (the
flag cannot be repeated).

options.name: --mount-id
options.description:
Id(s) of the settings mount to use when several
entries declare one virtual root (the <ulid>|
prefix of an entry in appsettings.json). Several
ids go space-separated after ONE --mount-id (the

options.name: --allow-external-mounts
options.description:
(Default: false) Allow mounts from directories
outside the workspace root. Mount base paths are
added to the security whitelist. Can also be
enabled for every invocation via
ORKEON_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_MOUNTS=1.

options.name: --llm-profile
options.description:
Run on the host LLM profile <id> (Llm:Profiles:<id>
in the settings) as this run's default: the Llm
section becomes that profile, whole, for every call
that names no profile of its own. An id the
settings do not define is refused, listing the ones
they do.

options.name: --llm-mock
options.description:
Answer every LLM call from this JSONL file instead
of a model, offline and deterministic: one
{"match", "regex"?, "content", "toolCalls"?} object
per line, the first line that matches the prompt
wins. Every LLM profile of the run becomes
Provider: mock reading this file. The file's folder
is mounted read-only at /llm-mock.

options.name: --llm-record
options.description:
Record every LLM call of the run, with its answer,
in this JSONL cassette (API keys and authorization
headers are redacted). The file's folder is mounted
read-write at /llm-cassette. Exclusive with
--llm-replay and --llm-mock.

options.name: --llm-replay
options.description:
Answer every LLM call of the run from this
cassette, recorded by --llm-record, with no
network: a call the cassette does not hold fails
with a replay miss. The file's folder is mounted
read-only at /llm-cassette. Exclusive with
--llm-record and --llm-mock.

options.name: --test
options.description:
(Default: false) Bind the global `test`
(test.mockLlm, test.mockTool,
test.assertLlmCalled...) in a script. An
expectation of test.mockLlm answers before the
configured LLM; without --test there is no `test`.

options.name: --no-decision
options.description:
(Default: false) Switch the decision circuit off
for this run, even when Orkeon:Decision:Enabled is
true: decision tasks answer from their fallback.

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
(Default: 0) Verbosity level: 0=quiet, 1=LLM & tool
exchanges, 2=full debug.

options.name: --llm-log
options.description:
(Default: false) Enable LLM exchange logging
(writes JSONL to ./llm-logs unless --llm-log-path
overrides).

options.name: --llm-log-path
options.description:
Directory for LLM exchange log files (.jsonl).
Implies --llm-log.

options.name: --inputs
options.description:
Inline JSON inputs forwarded as a global `inputs`
variable.

options.name: --inputs-file
options.description: Path to a JSON file holding the inputs.

options.name: --memory-limit-mb
options.description:
Jint memory limit in megabytes for this run
(overrides appsettings). Set 0 to disable; default
comes from
Orkeon:Scripting:Limits:MemoryLimitBytes.

options.name: --var
options.description:
Variable for a YAML crew's CrewInput (KEY=VALUE).
Several variables go space-separated after ONE
--var (the flag cannot be repeated). Used by task
templates: {KEY} → VALUE. Ignored for .ork.ts
scripts.

options.name: --initial-context
options.description:
Initial context string passed to a YAML crew's
CrewInput. Ignored for .ork.ts scripts.

options.name: --events
options.description:
Emit the versioned JSONL event protocol on stdout
(task progress, cost, run outcome) instead of plain
text. This is how a client drives a run.

options.name: --stream
options.description:
(Default: false) With --events, also emit llm.delta
events token by token. Verbose by nature: off
unless asked for.

options.name: --client
options.description:
(Default: client) With --events, the name of the
observing peer on the hub (client://<name>). Agents
can post and send to that address; a crew's links:
block authorizes it.

options.name: --validate
options.description:
(Default: false) Dry-run: resolve settings, build
the host and load the crew (strict tool resolution)
WITHOUT probing the LLM endpoint or running a
kickoff. Prints 'VALIDATION OK/FAILED: <config>
...' and exits 0 (ok) or non-zero (failed).

options.name: --resume
options.description:
Resume the checkpointed run <id> of this crew, or
'latest' for its most recent unfinished run: the
tasks it had completed are not run again. Needs
Orkeon:Checkpointing:Enabled; refused with
--validate. With --events, name the run id (latest
is refused).

options.name: --input
options.description:
The answer to the question the resumed run stopped
on (the run exited 75): only with --resume. The
task that asked is replayed and finds the answer;
the tasks already done are not run again.

options.name: --list-tools
options.description:
(Default: false) Build the host and print the
sorted list of registered tool names (one per line)
to stdout, then exit 0. No crew is loaded, so the
crew path is not required.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description:
Path to the crew definition: .ork.ts/.js (Scripting
DSL), .yaml/.yml (YAML crew), or a directory
holding a multi-file YAML crew (config.yaml +
agents/ + tasks/). Required unless --list-tools.

Write one use case as a team folder — crew/, its data/, its output
folders and team.json — a team folder a client can import as it is.

options.description:
Required. The team folder to write: created when absent; an
existing folder must be empty — an export never merges.

options.description:

of the query (read from the text when omitted); for an export,
the language of the team's name and description; otherwise the
language of the titles shown (default en).
